**3B.1 Research Note: Vladimir Putin in 2024**

Bottom line: the 2024 record is **strongly against** protecting residents from state violence, torture, political imprisonment, extrajudicial killing, and arbitrary punishment. The only weak pro-side signal is a broad military-discipline decree, which does not meaningfully offset the repeated abuse findings.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| Slightly for 3B.1, but indirect | `Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 01.03.2024 г. № 162` | Kremlin | 2024-03-01 | https://www.kremlin.ru/acts/bank/50378/print | Putin amended military statutes to require commanders to prevent crimes and incidents, report problems promptly, and respond to weapons-storage alarms. This is the only 2024 item that weakly points toward restraint or discipline, but it is broad governance rather than protection from state violence or abuse. | 3B.1 |
| Against 3B.1 | `UN says Russia continues to torture, execute Ukrainian POWs` | United Nations in Ukraine | 2024-03-26 | https://ukraine.un.org/en/264368-un-says-russia-continues-torture-execute-ukrainian-pows | The UN mission said almost every interviewed POW described torture, with more than half reporting sexual violence. This is direct evidence against humane treatment and against protection from torture and arbitrary punishment. | 3B.1 |
| Against 3B.1 | `Ukraine human rights situation remains bleak three years after Russia’s full-scale armed ...` | United Nations in Ukraine | 2024-12-31 | https://ukraine.un.org/en/286771-ukraine-human-rights-situation-remains-bleak-three-years-after-russia%E2%80%99s-full-scale-armed | The UN said civilian casualties, executions, torture of POWs, and entrenchment in occupied territory continued at year-end. That is strong evidence against protection from state violence and unlawful punishment. | 3B.1 |
| Against 3B.1 | `Exclusive: Putin-controlled aircraft deported Ukrainian children, US-backed research alleges` | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-12-03 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/exclusiveputincontrolled-aircraft-deported-ukrainian-children-usbacked-research-alleges-3750835 | Reuters reported Yale researchers’ allegation that Russian presidential aircraft and funds were used in a child-transfer program. This is an allegation, not a judicial finding, but if accurate it points against protection from state coercion and unlawful conduct. | 3B.1 |
| Against 3B.1 | `Russia to practice tactical nuclear weapon scenario to deter West` | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-05-06 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russia-to-practice-tactical-nuclear-weapon-scenario-to-deter-west--defence-ministry-3419973 | Russia announced tactical nuclear deployment drills after claiming Western threats. This reflects a coercive wartime posture rather than protection from arbitrary or exemplary punishment. | 3B.1 |
| Against 3B.1 | `Russia begins second stage of tactical nuclear weapon drills with Belarus` | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-11 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russia-begins-second-stage-of-tactical-nuclear-weapon-drills-with-belarus-3478894 | The drill phase with Belarus expanded readiness and cross-border operationalization. It shows sustained escalation and alliance leverage, not protection from state violence or unlawful punishment. | 3B.1 |
| Against 3B.1 | `Russia will change nuclear doctrine because of Western role in Ukraine` | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-09-01 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russia-will-change-nuclear-doctrine-due-to-wests-actions-in-ukraine-official-says-3596699 | Moscow justified the doctrine revision as a response to Western involvement in Ukraine. This is coercive escalation framing, not a sign of protecting residents from violence or restraint in punishment. | 3B.1 |

**Synthesis**

- Best-supported answer: **No**.
- The strongest evidence is repeated UN reporting on **torture, executions, sexual violence, and civilian harm**.
- The child-transfer allegation is not a final legal finding, but it is still relevant as a serious accountability signal.
- The only pro-side evidence is a general military-discipline decree, which does not show actual protection from state violence or arbitrary punishment.
- Search gap: I did **not** find credible 2024 evidence of Putin reducing torture, political imprisonment, disappearances, extrajudicial killing, or exemplary punishment inside Russia or in occupied territory.
